contents.content:
Bangalore is a big city with people from many places, making it a diverse and interesting place to live. While known for its IT companies and startups, Bangalore also offers many good schools with a range of subjects and activities for students of all ages.

Table of Contents

Key Takeaways

  • The top 5 schools in Bangalore are The HDFC School, Bangalore, Inventure Academy, Oakridge  International School, National Public School, Indiranagar, and Greenwood High School.
  •  These schools offer a high-quality education that follows different boards such as CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE, and IB, and prepares students for the board exams and competitive exams.
  • These schools have spacious classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, libraries, sports complexes, auditoriums, cafeterias, and other facilities that enhance the learning environment and the student experience.
  • These schools have a wide range of extracurricular activities that include arts, music, drama, sports, leadership, entrepreneurship, social responsibility, and global exchange programs that develop students’ skills and interests beyond academics.

HDFC School, Bangalore, is a respected school, especially for students following the CBSE board. It's part of a larger group with schools in other places too. Started in 2016, it's grown quickly. They focus on helping students learn for life and become good citizens. They have a friendly and supportive environment where students can study well, be creative, and even invent things! They value being honest, respectful, working together, and always trying their best.

Annual Fees :The HDFC School in Bangalore has different fees depending on your grade level. For younger students (Nursery to Grade 5), the yearly cost ranges from ₹1,27,200 to ₹2,07,720. Additionally, there are one-time fees: a ₹1,000 registration fee, a ₹60,000 admission fee, and a refundable deposit of ₹30,000  and also an annual charge of ₹34,400.

Academic Curriculum:
Bangalore's HDFC School teaches kids from kindergarten to 12th grade using the CBSE board. They offer many different subjects and extra classes . They want students to learn by asking questions, exploring, and using what they know. The school even uses computers and other tech tools to make learning fun and easier. They help students get ready for their big exams like JEE, NEET, and CLAT by giving them practice and tips from experienced teachers.

Facilities:
HDFC School, Bangalore, has nice classrooms with smart boards and tools to help with learning. They have labs for science experiments and a library with books, magazines, and computers. For sports, they have a field and courts for many games. Students can even perform on a big stage. They have a cafeteria serving healthy lunch and snacks.

Extracurricular Activities
Bangalore's HDFC School has more than just books. They have clubs for reading, science, and math, and even ones for history and nature lovers.  They have clubs for singing, acting, and drawing. The school holds fun competitions like science fairs and spelling bees. They even have a special program where students learn about different countries. They have projects for cleaning the city, donating gifts, and visiting older people. This school helps kids learn and grow in many ways.

Inventure Academy in Bangalore is a top school for ICSE,IB, and IGCSE boards, open to both boys and girls. Started in 2005, they help students learn for life and become responsible people who make a positive impact. They value kindness, honesty, and doing their best in everything.

Annual Fees : For the academic year 2024-25, the annual fees at Inventure Academy are ₹ 3,11,000 (Rupees Three Lakh Eleven Thousand). Additional fees, such as transport and admission fees, should also be considered. For more information on the fee structure, please visit the school's website.

Academic Curriculum:
Bangalore's Inventure Academy teaches kids from kindergarten to 12th grade using ICSE IB and IGCSE boards. They mix Indian and international learning styles to help students grow in all areas. They encourage kids to follow their interests and offer extra classes they can choose from. They even help students get ready for big exams like SATs and TOEFLs by giving them practice and tips from experienced teachers.

Facilities:
Inventure Academy has neat classrooms with smart boards and projectors to help with learning. They have labs for science experiments and a library filled with books, magazines, and even computers for research! For sports, they have a field and courts for many games. Students can even perform on a big stage! They have a hall serving healthy lunch and snacks. This school offers learning with modern tools and facilities.

Extracurricular Activities:
Inventure Academy has fun things to do after school. They have activities like singing acting or playing sports. They even help kids learn about starting their own business. They have cool contests like science fairs and debates too. They have programs where you meet kids from other countries. So, learning and fun go hand in hand at this school.

Oakridge International School in Bangalore is a top school for the IB board, open to both boys and girls with day and boarding options. Founded in 2008, they aim to be the best and teach kids about different cultures while making them responsible leaders who can change things. They value respect, doing what's right, being honest, caring for others, and always trying their best. 

Annual Fees: At Oakridge International School, the yearly fee is ₹3,90,000.There are extra charges like transport and application fees. You can find more details about the fee structure on the school's website.

Academic Curriculum:
Bangalore's Oakridge International School teaches kids from kindergarten to 12th grade using the IB board. They ask questions and explore to learn in a challenging way. They have programs for all ages, from little kids to teenagers. They even have extra classes kids can choose from if they want to learn more about something they like. The school helps students get ready for big exams like SATs and TOEFLs by giving them practice and tips from experienced teachers.

Facilities:
Oakridge School in Bangalore has neat things to help kids learn! They have classrooms with special boards and projectors, making learning interesting. Science explorers can do experiments in their labs. They even have a big library with books and computers for research. They have a field for cricket, football, and more. Students can even perform on a stage and when it's lunchtime, they have healthy food in their cafeteria. This school helps kids learn with modern tools and facilities.

Extracurricular Activities
Oakridge International School offers more than just classes  For reading, science, or math They have groups for that! They have classes for singing and dancing too. The school holds fun contests like science fairs and spelling bees to keep things interesting. They even have programs where you meet kids from other countries.

National Public School in Indiranagar is a great option for kids studying CBSE, open to both boys and girls. It was started in 1982. It's a friendly place where kids can learn a lot and grow up well. They believe in being respectful, honest, helpful, and always doing their best. It is a part of the  National Public School group, which has branches in Rajajinagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, and Chennai. National Public School, Indiranagar has a vision to provide quality education that fosters academic excellence, character development, and social responsibility.

Annual Fees: The annual fee at NPS Indiranagar is ₹ 170,000 (Rupees One Lakh Seventy Thousand). Additional charges like admission fees are also levied. For a detailed overview of the complete fee structure, you can visit the school's website.

Academic Curriculum:
National Public School, Indiranagar follows the CBSE board and offers a comprehensive and balanced education for students from Pre-Nursery to Grade 12. The school has a curriculum that covers all the core subjects and electives that students need. The school also integrates technology and digital tools in the teaching and learning process, to enhance learning outcomes and student engagement. The school prepares students for the board exams and the competitive exams, such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, etc by providing them with coaching and guidance from expert faculty and mentors.

Facilities:
Bangalore's National Public School has neat things to help kids learn. They have classrooms with special boards and projectors, making learning interesting. Science explorers can do experiments in their labs. They even have a big library with books and computers for research. They have a field for cricket, football, and more. Students can even perform on a stage. And when it's lunchtime, they have healthy food in their cafeteria. This school helps kids learn with modern tools and facilities, making it a good choice for boys and girls.

Extracurricular Activities
Bangalore's National Public School has fun stuff to do after school.  For reading, science, or art students can join various groups  The school holds cool competitions like science fairs and spelling bees.  They even have programs where you can help people in your city.

Bangalore's Greenwood High is a top choice for ICSE, IGCSE, and IB students, open to both boys and girls. The school was started in 2004 and offer day and boarding options. They aim to be the best by giving kids quality education that helps them shine in everything they do. They teach in different ways so kids can learn creatively and think for themselves. They value respect, doing what's right, being honest, caring for others, and always trying their best.

Annual Fees : Greenwood High School fees vary depending on your grade level. The annual fee at Greenwood High School is ₹ 3,00,000 . Visit the school website for the most current and accurate information.

Academic Curriculum:
Greenwood High in Bangalore teaches kids from little ones (Pre-Nursery) to big kids (Grade 12). They follow ICSE, IGCSE, and IB boards. They have different classes and things to do based on what you like. They even use tech tools to make learning fun and interesting for the students.

Facilities
Bangalore's Greenwood High has special things to help kids learn. Big rooms with smart boards make learning fun. Students can do experiments in their Labs They have a huge library with books and computers. Students can play cricket, football and other sports.They even have healthy food for lunch. Greenwood High helps kids learn and grow in many ways.

Extracurricular Activities
Bangalore's Greenwood High has extra stuff after school. For painting, singing, dancing, or sports students can join groups. They have clubs for science, history, and more. They hold fun competitions like science fairs and spelling bees.  They even take trips to other countries. So, learning and doing new things go together at this school.

Conclusion

Bangalore offers a variety of excellent schools, each with its own unique curriculum, facilities, and activities. Whether it's The HDFC School focusing on CBSE education, Inventure Academy offering ICSE and IGCSE boards, or Oakridge International School emphasizing the IB curriculum, parents have many options for their child's education. Similarly, National Public School, Indiranagar, and Greenwood High School prioritize academic excellence, character development, and social responsibility, providing a supportive environment for students to thrive.

FAQS

Q: What are the best schools in Bangalore for the CBSE board? 
A: In Bangalore, several schools offer CBSE education. Some of them are The HDFC School, National Public School in Indiranagar, and Delhi Public School in Bangalore East, etc.

Q: What are the best schools in Bangalore for the IGCSE board? 
A: The best schools in Bangalore for the IGCSE board are Inventure Academy, Greenwood High School, Mallya Aditi International School, etc. These schools are known for good teaching and helping kids learn well.

Q: How to get admission to the top schools in Bangalore?
A: The admission process and criteria of the top schools in Bangalore differ from school to school. Generally, the admission process involves filling out an online or offline application form, submitting the required documents, paying the registration fee, appearing for an entrance test or interview, and securing a seat based on merit or availability. Some schools may also have a lottery system or a waiting list. You can check the admission dates, eligibility, and procedure of each school on their websites or by calling them.

Q: What are the facilities and infrastructure of the top schools in Bangalore? 
A:The top schools in Bangalore offer a range of facilities and infrastructure to enhance the learning and development of their students.
Common facilities and infrastructure include:

  • Spacious and well-equipped classrooms Libraries, laboratories and computer rooms. 
  • Sports fields, courts, and swimming pools.
  • Auditoriums, amphitheaters, and multipurpose halls.
  •  Cafeterias, canteens, and transport services 
  • Hostels, dormitories, and medical centers.
  • Art, music, dance, and drama studios.
  • Clubs, societies, and student councils.
